description: This file defines a custom control 'OverflowTextBlock' for a UWP application, including properties, methods for scrolling, accessibility, and template handling.

classes.name: OverflowTextBlock
classes.description: A custom control for displaying overflowing text with scroll buttons and accessibility features.

classes.name: OverflowButtonPlacement
classes.description: An enum indicating the placement of scroll buttons, either inline or above.

methods.name: OnTokensUpdatedPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the TokensUpdated property changes, updating layout and accessibility view.

methods.name: OnScrollButtonsPlacementPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the placement of scroll buttons and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateScrollButtons
methods.description: Updates the visibility and focus of scroll buttons based on content size and scroll position.

methods.name: UnregisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Removes event handlers for scroll buttons and view changes.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Initializes template parts and sets up event handlers when the control template is applied.

methods.name: OnCreateAutomationPeer
methods.description: Creates an automation peer for accessibility support.

methods.name: OnScrollLeftClick
methods.description: Scrolls content to the left when the left button is clicked.

methods.name: OnScrollRightClick
methods.description: Scrolls content to the right when the right button is clicked.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Updates scroll button visibility when the view changes.

methods.name: UpdateVisualState
methods.description: Updates visual state based on whether the control is active.
